description: FIRST-TOUCH: lower the 'controllable relative speed' base from 16 to 10 km/h. Threshold = 16 + 19f + 3g km/h (f = normalised Ball Control x trap.ballControlRate); below it the situational difficulty D is exactly 0 and a touch is perfect. Re-aims the 16.0 operand at the existing 10.0 cell 0x145a8dd7c, so every player's touch starts going loose 6 km/h earlier. Same zero-for-elites caveat as trap-difficulty-x2.json.
